segments.ja432:1.1: Bahussutaṃ cittakathiṃ [cittakathaṃ (syā. ka.)], gaṅgā vahati pāṭaliṃ [pāṭalaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja432:1.3: Vuyhamānaka bhaddante, ekaṃ me dehi gāthakaṃ [gītakaṃ (ka. aṭṭha.)].
segments.ja432:2.1: Yena siñcanti dukkhitaṃ, yena siñcanti āturaṃ;
segments.ja432:2.3: Tassa majjhe marissāmi, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja432:3.1: Yattha bījāni rūhanti, sattā yattha patiṭṭhitā;
segments.ja432:3.3: Sā me sīsaṃ nipīḷeti, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja432:4.1: Yena bhattāni paccanti, sītaṃ yena vihaññati;
segments.ja432:4.3: So maṃ ḍahati [dayhati (ka.)] gattāni, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja432:5.1: Yena bhuttena [bhattena (syā. ka.)] yāpenti, puthū brāhmaṇakhattiyā;
segments.ja432:5.3: So maṃ bhutto byāpādeti, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja432:6.3: So maṃ [so me (sī. pī.)] bhañjati gattāni, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja432:7.1: Yaṃ nissitā jagatiruhaṃ, svāyaṃ aggiṃ pamuñcati;
segments.ja432:7.3: Disā bhajatha vakkaṅgā, jātaṃ saraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja432:8.3: Sā maṃ gharā nicchubhati [nīharati (sī. syā.)], jātaṃ saraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja432:9.1: Yena jātena nandissaṃ, yassa ca bhavamicchisaṃ;
segments.ja432:9.3: So maṃ gharā nicchubhati [nīharati (sī. syā.)], jātaṃ saraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja432:10.1: Suṇantu me jānapadā, negamā ca samāgatā;
segments.ja432:10.3: Yatodakaṃ tadādittaṃ, yato khemaṃ tato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja432:11.1: Rājā vilumpate raṭṭhaṃ, brāhmaṇo ca purohito;
